name: Melpot
description:
Melpot – Communities That Create Value

Melpot is a community-driven social platform where creators and groups come together to build, manage, and monetize their content, all in one place.

Unlike traditional social networks, Melpot is built around communities, not feeds. Whether you’re a creator, educator, or niche group leader, Melpot gives you the tools to grow an audience, engage deeply, and generate revenue, without juggling multiple platforms.

What you can do on Melpot

Build and join communities
	•	Create or join interest-based communities around topics you care about
	•	Engage through posts, images, videos, and voice content
	•	Participate in focused, meaningful conversations, not noise

Create and share content
	•	Publish posts, media, and updates inside your community
	•	Interact through reactions, comments, and discussions
	•	Discover new communities aligned with your interests

Monetize your content (for creators)
	•	Choose monetization models that fit your business
	•	Manage members, content access, and revenue in one place
	•	Track performance and earnings transparently

Stay connected, your way
	•	Follow creators and communities you trust
	•	Control what you see, who you engage with, and how you participate
	•	Enjoy a cleaner, more intentional social experience

Melpot is designed for creators and communities who want ownership, control, and sustainability, not just reach.

Join communities that matter.
Build value, not just followers.

name: LandBurro: Hunt, Fish & Camp
description:
Getting outdoors has never been easier. Find and book daily rentals for land, lodging and experiences on LandBurro . LandBurro was founded by outdoorsmen for outdoorsmen and completely free to join! We enable guests to experience an abundance of outdoor activities on private land such as hunting, fishing, hiking, camping, picnicking, biking, kayaking, etc. while creating meaningful revenue opportunities for landowners. LandBurro is proud to be the home to the largest selection of allowed outdoor activities and experiences of any online marketplace in the U.S. 

LandBurro is designed to connect people who want to rent their property with people who want to rent it - short term rentals for land, experiences and lodging. It’s Airbnb meets land - land on demand. The platform is designed to provide the flexibility that landowners and guests desire - easy, noncommittal and safe. Landowners maintain complete control over their property with the ability to block out dates, set property rules, and outline activities allowed on their property, all while being backed by a LandBurro $1 million general liability insurance policy. At the same time, guests are able to select the length of stay, budget, location and activities that work best for them. While anyone can enjoy public lands, having access to a private piece of land for your own solitary enjoyment offers a different type of joy!

Features of the app: 
- Search outdoor stays based on geolocation
- Check real time availability of the properties
- Search based on dates available
- Filter search results based on your needs and desires (price, activities, amenities, user reviews)
- Quick search function based on activity
- Easily switch between map view and list view in the search results
- Save properties in your favorites
- Become a Host. List your property on LANDBURRO and begin earning money today!
- Purchase Gift Cards
- LandHosts are able to blackout dates that property will not be available.
- Earn BurroBucks (our rewards program) through completing bookings.
- Access and edit your account information
- See past trips and future trips 
- Share properties and trips with friends

The Great Outdoors is at your fingertips and happiness awaits! Download our app and go explore! Experience life.

LandBurro was created to make a difference - whether in the life of a landowner, outdoor enthusiast, or child - we’re in pursuit to make your life better. The pursuit to make the life of others better doesn’t stop here, at least 10% of LANDBURRO’s annual profit will be donated every year to non-profits, churches, and other charity groups focused on land conservation, rural communities, children well-being and mental health. 

Use our hashtags on Instagram, Facebook and Twitter: #landbum #landburro
